canDoYue: 你識喺電話問珠寶存貨，仲識預留同聽日嚟取。
canDoEn: Ask about jewellery stock on the phone, then reserve a piece and collect it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning, you are calling the jewellery shop, and I can see our stock on the shelf.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。你打嚟珠寶舖，我可以睇吓架上嘅存貨。
dialogue.say: Good morning, you are calling the jewellery shop, and I can see our stock on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Have you kept a similar gold bracelet in stock, and is one still available to reserve today?
dialogue.glossYue: 你有冇類似嘅金手鏈存貨，今日仲有冇得預留？
dialogue.say: Have you kept a similar gold bracelet in stock, and is one still available to reserve today?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I will describe the gold piece, and I can hold it here until you collect it tomorrow.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會描述呢件金飾，你可以聽日嚟取，我可以喺度留住。
dialogue.say: I will describe the gold piece, and I can hold it here until you collect it tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please text me when it's ready, and then please confirm the opening hours at your location.
dialogue.glossYue: 貨準備好就發短訊話我知，然後再確認舖頭開門時間同位置。
dialogue.say: Please text me when it's ready, and then please confirm the opening hours at your location.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have called to ask about stock, and I will collect the bracelet tomorrow after you confirm.
dialogue.glossYue: 我打嚟問存貨，你確認之後我聽日嚟取條手鏈。
dialogue.say: I have called to ask about stock, and I will collect the bracelet tomorrow after you confirm.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Our shop hours are on the door, and the address is beside the market on this street.
dialogue.glossYue: 舖頭時間貼喺門上面，地址就喺呢條街市旁邊。
dialogue.say: Our shop hours are on the door, and the address is beside the market on this street.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you reserve a similar gold piece, and will you hold it under the name Mei?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以預留一件類似嘅金飾，用 Mei 個名留住？
dialogue.say: Can you reserve a similar gold piece, and will you hold it under the name Mei?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I will leave a message, and I note the piece is available for you to gather Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會留低訊息，我記低嗰件星期五可以攞。
dialogue.say: I will leave a message, and I note the piece is available for you to gather Friday.
